architecture: shared frozen TAU feature extractor -> geometry/transport candidate bank -> budget-constrained regional routing
budget: all candidates matched to original geometry actual per-clip L1; mixtures capped at same budget
deployable: only fixed candidate selected by validation
regions: fixed grids 8/16/32 pixels; not object instance masks
scope: candidate-space diagnostic, not an optimal constrained mathematical bound
capacity_control: rgb_local reuses geometry-trained weights: not a separately trained RGB capacity control
candidate_count_control: amplitude bank has same number of entries as motion bank
